videos.title: New Apple child safety features help parents keep kids safe online
videos.description: Parents can now help keep kids even more safe on iPhone, iPad, and Mac with easier and more intuitive child safety features. Start with a Child Account tailored to their age, which kicks off safeguards and lets parents choose the exact apps that can be accessed on their child’s new iPhone or iPad. Communication Safety helps detect and block nudity and violence in shared images and video. Ask to Buy and Ask to Browse let parents decide which apps kids can download and which sites they can see. videos.description:

The titanium frame and hinge cover make it beautiful and durable. With a 48MP Dual Fusion camera system, A20 Pro chip, and all-day battery, it's an iPhone unlike any iPhone.
